column1: # Pronoun gender by interpretation (pronouns.py; see its docstring and rendering.md "Pronoun gender").
# WORD-ID<TAB>Globasa pronoun<TAB>note        — list a passage's pronouns: python3 pronouns.py suggest STREAM
# Defaults without an entry: te/ete/yu/uyu/mi/imi. te covers any life form (xwexi darsu 05: "animate: any
# life form"), so plants and animals need no entry; to/oto only for things. A masculine plural is mixed
# by default (ete, uyu): manete/manuyu only where the group is all male by interpretation. GENDER=1 adds
# the second person the grammar settles: 2 m sg manyu, 2 f sg femyu, 2 f pl femuyu.
# sesu: the possessor is the clause subject (rendering.md "Possessives"); elsewhere tesu/etesu by
# default (Gen 1:21, 24, 25 לְמִינָהּ: the subject is God, the waters or the earth, the kind is the creatures')

column3: Gen 1:11 עֵץ פְּרִי עֹשֶׂה פְּרִי לְמִינוֹ: the tree, subject of its own relative clause (draft 1:11). Not 1:12: there the kind belongs to the main clause, subject the earth (draft 1:12)
Gen 1:27 בְּצַלְמוֹ: God created humanity in his own image (God is subject and possessor)
